title: Sheet Pan Sausage and Vegetables
description: A one-pan roast of smoked sausage, potatoes and vegetables with almost no cleanup.

items: 14 oz smoked sausage, sliced into coins
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a large sheet pan with foil or parchment.
Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt and roast for 15 minutes.
Toss the sausage and remaining vegetables with the rest of the oil and seasonings.
Add them to the pan with the potatoes, spread in a single layer, and roast 15–20 minutes more until the potatoes are tender and everything is browned.

notes: Use two pans if crowded — crowding steams the vegetables instead of browning them.
